spec.hypothesis: Earlier static native fact memory may be unread or wrongly addressed. Measure actual attention mass and fact choice when its12 native K/V terminal states replace the same fixed prefix slots; separately measure information in each native query head using fixed class means.
spec.memory: The same12 independent fact states for every history, terminal pre-RoPE K and V, same slots7..18 as the earlier diagnostic. No question-dependent choice of memory values.
spec.virtual_attention: Reconstruct exact native attention and verify against captured head outputs. Replace only block14 prefix K/V algebraically, apply destination RoPE, then measure memory mass and conditional fact choice; do not propagate the virtual output into later blocks.
spec.query_geometry: For each of14 heads, mean first-query vector per12 factual relations plus one outside mean; subtract the mean of the13 centers and normalize for cosine classification. No value update, iterative search or selected winning head in this script.
spec.extra_relation_handling: Keep the two wood-finder queries separate and report their predictions without assigning them the wood-donor label. Prototype means already selected by the12 declared labels; no numerical prototype changes from this correction.
spec.outside_definition: External cases are outside the12 edited relation types; some mention Pinocchio, so this is not a claim that all are unrelated to the story.
spec.prefix_precision_check: Identical token prefix; relative norm difference below2e-5, recorded per sequence. Elementwise equality failed at4.20e-5 maximum absolute but2.35e-6 relative norm when sequence shape changed; repeated identical sequence was exact. Prefix is not asserted byte-identical across shapes.
